course_name_original: Projecto Integrador de 1º Ciclo em Engenharia Electrotécnica e de Computadores
course_name_en: 1st Cycle Integrated Project in Electrical and Computer Engineering
syllabus_topics: Project definition by supervisors or under their guidance
Project locations: IST, other universities, research centers, or companies
Modalities: Scientific Project (deep analysis of scientific, technological, or management challenges, possibly including experimental/computational work)
Modalities: Company Project (individual project focused on a specific company challenge, requiring short-term implementation solution/analysis)
Modalities: JUNO Project (multidisciplinary teamwork on real, complex problems from companies/institutions, requiring contributions from students of different IST/ULisboa courses)
Preparation phase: defining innovation challenge proposals (from faculty, researchers, companies, or student teams), team formation, supervisor assignment
Execution phase: teams define tasks for members, periodic meetings with supervisors, project status evaluation
First period of execution: problem assessment and solution design
Second period of execution: development, testing, and evaluation of the solution
Demonstration phase: oral evaluation of the project and individual contributions
Evaluation of communication materials by external juries
Public event for exhibiting team results

assessment_methods.method: Team project evaluation (Pg) - Quality of work (validation/evaluation of problem, prototype, validation of solution)
Team project evaluation (Pg) - Quality of presentation materials (final presentation, project page, demo video, poster)
Student involvement (Ei) - Presence in 5 or more team consultation hours
Student involvement (Ei) - Presence in 4 or more seminars
Student involvement (Ei) - Authorship of intermediate presentation

assessment_rules: The final grade (NF) for each student is calculated using the formula: NF = (0.8 x Ci + 0.2 x Ei) x Pg, where Pg is the team project grade, Ci is the individual contribution, and Ei is the student's involvement. Pg is evaluated on a scale of 0 to 20 based on project materials (pitch deck, landing page, demo video, poster). Ci is a unit value when the student's contribution equals the group average, assessed by authorship, assistant feedback, group member feedback, and oral explanation. Ei is evaluated on a scale of 0 to 1, summing points for presence in consultation hours (0.3), presence in seminars (0.3), and authorship of the intermediate presentation (0.4). Fraud, including unauthorized copying or use of information, will result in the annulment of all involved assessments and will be reported to the Pedagogical Council.
bibliography: Teams are responsible for researching relevant bibliographies for their project.
institution: Universidade De Lisboa — LEEC21 Eng. Eletrotécnica e de Computadores (IST)
degree: Licenciatura Bolonha em Engenharia Eletrotécnica e de Computadores (LEEC21)
